svg.title: White Yellow
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. White biomorphic figure independently hand traced from Sotheby photograph on yellow rectangular painted ground. Shape differs from Orange Blue despite related motif; all white regions remain artwork.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sothebys.com/en/auctions/ecatalogue/2015/contemporary-evening-n09345/lot.10.html; record sothebys-en-auctions-ecatalogue-2015-contemporary-evening-n09345-lot-10-html; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
